models.holds: units, siege engines, mantlets, debris, banners

axes: y up, +z front; .json layers[y][z][x]; .vox is MagicaVoxel z-up with vox_y = depth-1-z
note: Re-pathed from the package (Design/Reference/SiegePrototypeV2/manifest.json). Paths are relative to GameData/. Template costs are recounted under ADR-005: decorations cost as the material they sit in. For models, costM3 is absent: models set no costs. The .json is the only committed source; Tools/ExportVox.py writes a .vox beside it for MagicaVoxel (ADR-008).

assets.name: Ditch & rampart
assets.role: Dug as a pair; the spoil piles into a rampart on the keep side. Foot soldiers cross, machines cannot.
assets.authoring: auto-downsampled from 0.5 m authoring (majority of 2×2×2) — redraw natively at 1 m before final
knownIssues: Converted automatically from 0.5 m authoring (majority of 2 x 2 x 2); to be redrawn natively at 1 m before the M4 Siege castle is final.

The rampart holds 48 m3 against 32 m3 dug; the spoil must equal the rampart. The conversion also flattened the ditch to 3 m wide and 1 m deep, with a 1 m slot 2 m deep. The decided profile, 5 m wide and 2 m deep with 1:1 sides, steps on the 1 m grid from 4 m wide to 2 m and digs exactly 48 m3, so redrawing the ditch fixes both.
The new rampart is topped with grass; only the generator places grass, so a fresh rampart is bare earth.
